'''''Elaeagnus × reflexa''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]].<ref name="inaturalist-Elaeagnus reflexa">{{cite web |title=Elaeagnus reflexa |url=https://www.inaturalist.org/taxa/410339-Elaeagnus-reflexa |website=iNaturalist |access-date=2 October 2024 |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Description==
A small bush with alternate tapering leaves and red berries.

==Range==
It is found in Japan, and has been introduced to Australia and New Zealand.<ref>{{cite web |title=Elaeagnus x reflexa |url=https://www.worldfloraonline.org/taxon/wfo-0000663907 |website=World Flora Online |access-date=3 October 2024}}</ref>

It is considered a weed in New Zealand.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sullivan |first1=Jon |last2=Williams |first2=Peter |last3=Timmins |first3=Susan |title=Movement of exotic plants into coastal native forests from gardens in northern New Zealand. |journal=New Zealand Journal of Ecology |date=2005 |pages=1–10}}</ref>

==Taxonomy==
''Elaeagnus × reflexa'' is described as ''Elaeagnus reflexa''.
